subject: Aligning next steps: ML inference lab and engineering runthrough
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jordan <alex.jordan@cloudsentry.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Aligning next steps: ML inference lab and engineering runthrough

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: CloudSentry is focused on lowering inference latency for real-time scoring and centralizing model serving across multi-cloud deployments. We surfaced a few technical priorities (secure key management, predictable p99 latency, and region-aware routing) that would benefit from a hands-on session with our ML/infra engineers.

Proposal: schedule a 60–90 minute engineering runthrough where we walk through:
- Current CloudSentry traffic profile and target latency/SLOs
- Model & architecture constraints (frameworks, quantization tolerance)
- Live walkthrough of our runtime: routing, batching, KV cache, and fallback policies
- Integration checklist and next-step pilot plan

Can you share the preferred attendee list (engineer + infra lead + procurement if needed) and two 90-minute windows over the next 10 business days that work for you? We can include Marissa (ML infra lead) who will run the session.

I'll attach a short agenda and our standard security questionnaire for procurement review.

Thanks,

— Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood_ml_infra_agenda.odt (agenda outline)
Attachment: CloudSentry-security-questionnaire.pdf (security questionnaire)
From: Alex Jordan <alex.jordan@cloudsentry.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 10:33:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Aligning next steps: ML inference lab and engineering runthrough

Soojin —

Thanks for the recap and the materials. The agenda looks good. Attendees from our side would be:
- Alex Jordan (CTO) — architect + product
- Priya Menon (SRE lead) — infra & networking
- procurement@cloudsentry.com (for security/compliance review)

Proposed windows (all times in PDT):
1) Wednesday 24 Mar, 15:00–16:30
2) Friday 26 Mar, 09:00–10:30

Either works but we slightly prefer the 24th. For the agenda, can Marissa include a short segment (~15 min) on our recommended rollback/fallback flow and a short Q&A at the end focused on integration blockers? Also note procurement will start the security questionnaire review Monday — they may loop in a third-party audit contact.

Thanks,
Alex

On security questionnaire: See attached redlined copy from procurement (CloudSentry-security-questionnaire.pdf).
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jordan <alex.jordan@cloudsentry.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 17:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Aligning next steps: ML inference lab and engineering runthrough

Alex —

Perfect, thanks for the attendee list and the two options. We can do Wed 24 Mar 15:00–16:30 PDT. I will cover:
- 10m: brief intro to Redwood runtime architecture & deployment modes
- 25m: live demo (routing, batching, KV cache, quantized model variant fallback)
- 15m: rollback/fallback flows + canary policies (as requested)
- 15m: integration checklist + procurement/security touchpoints
- 15m: open Q&A and next steps (pilot proposal)

I will invite Ben Carter (serving runtime engineer) and Marcus Lin (deploy/infra) to join the demo; they will chime on ops and autoscaling. If procurement needs a separate call for the questionnaire, happy to set that up in parallel.

Marissa

Marissa Cole
ML Infrastructure Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood_ml_infra_agenda.odt (updated with timelines)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jordan <alex.jordan@cloudsentry.com>, procurement <procurement@cloudsentry.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 09:03:00 +0000
Subject: Confirmed: Wed 24 Mar 15:00–16:30 PDT — ML inference lab

Alex / procurement team —

Great — we are locked for Wednesday, 24 Mar 2027 from 15:00–16:30 PDT. Calendar invite will follow; please let me know if any of the named attendees need to be swapped. Links and pre-reads:
- Agenda (final): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcdEfGh_InfraAgenda
- Security questionnaire (submitted): CloudSentry-security-questionnaire.pdf
- HubSpot record: HS-00012345

Pre-call ask for CloudSentry:
- Share a sample inference trace and p95/p99 metrics if available (helps tune batching)
- Confirm whether any models are Triton-based or using custom CUDA kernels

Thanks everyone — look forward to the session.

Best,
Soojin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
Attachment: calendar-invite.ics (slot booked)
